about_the_game:
In this demo, you'll play a small portion of the first chapter of "A Life's Journey" to get acquainted with the basic mechanics, the soundtrack (I love kick-ass battle music!), and the game's atmosphere. The playtime is approximately 6-10 hours, depending on your desire to grind and your drive for perfectionism. ;)
Steam Achievements aren't fully integrated into the demo version. However, there's an integrated achievement system as a taster.
Save data will most likely not be transferable to the full version.

I'd be happy to receive constructive feedback!
